title: 잭팟 던전
description:
Test your luck!

Features

- 20 different winning lines

- Aim for a win with 5 symbols

- Attack enemies with attack symbols

- Recharge your shield with defense symbols

- Restore health with recovery symbols

- Various monsters across 3 chapters

Introduction

- Have you been racking your brains trying to strategize?

- Now, try solving everything with luck!

- The game offers an auto-reel spin feature for you.

Controls

- Simply spin the reels with your mouse.

- Fun just like spinning a slot machine!
description_short: How far will your luck go? Jackpot Dungeon tests your luck. A game where you challenge with luck rather than skill, and it ends with luck! No more headaches strategizing.
